  fished_date_doy,
  COUNT(*) as trip_count,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  ROUND(AVG(yt), 2) as avg_yt
FROM trips
GROUP BY fished_date_doy
ORDER BY fished_date_doy

sql:
SELECT 
  boat,
  cls,
  COUNT(*) as trips,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  ROUND(AVG(yt), 2) as avg_yt_per_trip
FROM trips
WHERE fished_date_doy BETWEEN 92 AND 97
GROUP BY boat, cls
ORDER BY avg_yt_per_trip DESC
LIMIT 20
